# Soulcare by Monika Arora

> Soulcare is a private counselling practice run by Monika Arora, a Counselling Psychologist
> based in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India. The practice offers confidential, evidence-based
> psychological support for adolescents and adults via online and in-person sessions.

Monika Arora holds academic qualifications in Psychology, Guidance & Counselling, and Child
Guidance & Counselling. She uses Cognitive Behaviour Therapy (CBT) and a
Psychodynamic-Informed Approach. Since founding Soulcare in May 2025, she has supported
over 100 clients.

## Key Pages

- [About Monika Arora](https://soulcarebymonika.com/about): Background, qualifications, and therapeutic approach
- [Sessions & Services](https://soulcarebymonika.com/sessions): Overview of all counselling services offered
- [Individual Counselling](https://soulcarebymonika.com/sessions/individual-adults): For adults dealing with anxiety, depression, stress, burnout, grief, PTSD, OCD, phobias
- [Couple Therapy](https://soulcarebymonika.com/sessions/couple-therapy): For couples navigating communication, trust, and relationship challenges
- [Family Therapy](https://soulcarebymonika.com/sessions/family-therapy): For families dealing with conflict, parenting, or generational challenges
- [Adolescence Counselling](https://soulcarebymonika.com/sessions/adolescence): For teenagers dealing with academic pressure, social challenges, and identity
- [Personal Growth](https://soulcarebymonika.com/sessions/personal-growth): For building confidence, emotional intelligence, and self-awareness
- [Specialized Support](https://soulcarebymonika.com/sessions/specialized-support): For trauma, PTSD, and addiction
- [FAQ](https://soulcarebymonika.com/faq): Common questions about sessions, fees, confidentiality, and booking
- [How It Works](https://soulcarebymonika.com/how-it-works): Step-by-step guide to starting therapy at Soulcare
- [Blog](https://soulcarebymonika.com/blog): Articles on mental health, emotional wellbeing, anxiety, stress, and relationships
- [Book a Session](https://soulcarebymonika.com/book-a-session): Contact and appointment booking
